name: Eldorado Gold Corporation
moat_justification: A gold miner is a pure price taker: the only durable advantages are cost-curve position, reserve life and jurisdiction, and Eldorado's are weak-to-moderate. The return history proves it: the roic_proxy series in fundamentals.json runs 4.72% (FY2021), 0.96% (FY2022), 3.27% (FY2023), 7.34% (FY2024) and 14.88% (FY2025) — below a plausible cost of capital in four of the last five years, clearing it only in FY2025 at a $3,505/oz realized gold price. Gross margin moved 30.8% (FY2021), 19.7% (FY2022), 26.6% (FY2023), 38.3% (FY2024), 48.5% (FY2025) on the gold price alone, not on pricing power the company controls. What keeps it above 0-2 is a real asset base: the Skouries copper-gold porphyry (long life, copper credits guide its AISC to -$100 to $200/oz), a diversified producing base across Canada, Greece and Türkiye, and a 25.5M oz gold-equivalent proven and probable reserve base. Against that: a mid-to-high current cost position (Q2 2026 consolidated AISC $1,926/oz), Greece/Türkiye permitting and jurisdiction risk that delayed Skouries for years, and reserves that deplete and must be replaced with capex that has consumed all of operating cash flow (FY2025 capex $866.4M against OCF $742.5M).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.8%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 40-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-27, SEC CIK 918608): the securities registered under Section 12(b) are the company's common shares, trading symbol EGO, listed directly on the New York Stock Exchange — the NYSE security is the common share itself, not an ADS; company disclosure in its own releases states 'Eldorado's common shares trade on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: ELD) and the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: EGO)') so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
one_liner: Price-taking gold miner in a heavy build phase, moat 3/10 — Tier F: no positive normalized owner's earnings (3-yr median OE/share is -$0.15; OE positive in only 2 of the last 5 fiscal years, and FY2025 OE was -$144.1M as Skouries capex peaked), so the OE DCF produces no IV and no price clears a 15% hurdle on normalized numbers; the $35.15 price is a bet on sustained ~$4,000+ gold and Skouries delivering from Q4 2026, not on through-cycle earnings power.
moat_for: Skouries copper-gold porphyry: long mine life with copper byproduct credits guiding AISC to -$100 to $200/oz — a genuinely low-cost asset once in commercial production (Q4 2026 targeted)
Diversified producing base — Lamaque (Canada), Olympias (Greece), Kisladag and Efemcukuru (Türkiye) — no single-mine dependence
Reserve scale and growth path: 25.5M oz proven and probable gold-equivalent reserves (company investor materials); guided production growth of ~41% by 2028 as Skouries and McIlvenna Bay ramp
moat_against: Pure gold price taker — no pricing power; margins are set by the gold price, not the company
ROIC below the cost of capital in four of the last five years (roic_proxy 4.72% FY2021, 0.96% FY2022, 3.27% FY2023, 7.34% FY2024); FY2025's 14.88% is a peak-gold print
Mid-to-high current cost position: consolidated AISC $1,926/oz in Q2 2026 at the operating mines
Reserves deplete — every ounce must be replaced via capex or M&A; FY2025 capex of $866.4M exceeded operating cash flow of $742.5M
Jurisdiction and permitting risk in Greece and Türkiye; Skouries was delayed for years and first concentrate slipped again to Q3 2026 with ~$50M of added construction capital
Dilution: diluted share count compounding at 3.8%/yr (engine); SBC nearly doubled in FY2025 to $20.2M
